property.name: SpecularIntensity
property.description: Intensity multiplier applied to emissive lighting.

property.name: EmissiveIntensity
property.description: Intensity multiplier applied to specular lighting.

property.name: Color
property.description: Multiplier applied to the sampled reflection color.

property.name: VerticalOffset
property.description: World-space height at which the reflection fades out.

property.name: VerticalBias
property.description: Signed vertical reflection feather in world units. Negative values apply reflections from the top, positive values from the bottom, and absolute value controls the feather distance.

property.name: Color
property.description: Multiplier applied to the sampled skybox reflection color.

property.name: VerticalOffset
property.description: World-space height at which the skybox reflection fades out.

property.name: VerticalBias
property.description: Signed vertical reflection feather in world units. Negative values apply reflections from the top, positive values from the bottom, and absolute value controls the feather distance.
